newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Rio Hotel & Casino started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Rio Hotel & Casino started.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc said Monday it initiated coverage of Rio Hotel & Casino Inc with a buy rating and a 12-month price target of $21.

-- Rodman said Rio has all of the most favorable characteristics of much larger companies in the gaming industry group including excellent management, a clean balance sheet, land for development potential and a well-conceived product.

-- Rio recently completed a major expansion of its base property about a mile from the Las Vegas strip, and Rodman expects the expansion will nearly double the company's operating cash flow, which reached $55.5 million in 1996.
-- Rio operates a hotel and casino in Las Vegas.
-- Its shares were off 1/8 Monday at 13-3/4.
